data.raw_text:
‘WALANG LUGAR SA LIPUNAN ANG MGA BASTOS!’

Nagsagawa ng protest march ang World March of Women-Pilipinas kasama ang ilan pang grupo gaya ng Women's Legal and Human Rights Bureau mula Philippine Children’s Medical Center hanggang sa Office of the Ombudsman ngayong Biyernes, Marso 6.

Nagsampa ng reklamo ang mga grupo laban kay Quezon City 4th District Rep. Bong Suntay sa umano’y paglabag nito sa Safe Spaces Act, the Magna Carta of Women, at Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees. 

Ito ay dahil sa ‘nag-init’ statement ni Suntay tungkol sa aktres at TV host na si Anne Curtis na anila’y “sexist” at “inappropriate.”

“Acts of sexual violence and sexist behavior against women and girls continue to be normalized, as though they are an inevitable part of women’s daily lives. 
We refuse to accept this reality,” giit pa ng Women's Legal and Human Rights Bureau sa isang Facebook statement. (via Bea Tanierla)

Photo courtesy: Women's Legal and Human Rights Bureau/Facebook
